title: Independent families have cardinality at most that of a spanning set
statement: Let $K$ be a field [def-weil-field], let $M$ be a $K$-vector space, let $I$ be a set, and let $(v_i)_{i\in I}$ be linearly independent: every finite relation $\sum_i a_i v_i=0$, with $a_i\in K$, has all $a_i=0$. If $W\subseteq M$ spans $M$ over $K$ (every element is a finite $K$-linear combination of elements of $W$), then $|I|\leq |W|$. Here $|I|\leq|W|$ means that an injection $I\to W$ exists; universe lifts are understood.
